environment.mode_description: Breakout Game 1, the default one-player game

completion.definition: The player destroys both consecutive brick walls in one-player Breakout Game 1.
completion.score_signal: Cumulative unmodified ALE rewards, which expose the ROM's score increments.
completion.failure_policy: Unsupported environment, mode, ALE version, ROM checksum, or ALE interface yields cleared=null. No screen-only guess is used.

ale_episode_signals.game_over: Normal loss after lives are exhausted; it is not a full-clear signal.
ale_episode_signals.game_truncated: The configured 108000-emulator-frame episode limit; it is not a full-clear signal.
ale_episode_signals.ram: ALE exposes 128 RAM bytes. No individual RAM address has been validated as a full-clear flag, so the detector does not rely on an unverified offset.

failure_semantics.normal_loss: terminated=true remains stop_reason=terminated and is separately reported as completion_outcome=game_over when the audited detector is available.
failure_semantics.time_limit: truncated=true with ALE's frame-limit signal remains stop_reason=time_limit and completion_outcome=time_limit.
failure_semantics.unsupported_detector: cleared=null and clear_rate=null; an unknown detector result is not counted as a failed clear.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Evaluation exceptions abort the run; the CLI reports Evaluation failed and exits nonzero instead of writing a zero-clear episode.

aggregation.clear_rate: clear_count / total_episodes only when clear status is known for every episode; otherwise null.
aggregation.clear_times: Successful clears only, reported in agent steps and emulator frames.
aggregation.p90: Nearest-rank percentile: sorted_values[ceil(0.9 * n) - 1]; one sample reports that sample and zero samples report null.

explicit_mode_parity.result: ALE defaults and explicit mode=0,difficulty=0 produced identical observations, rewards, termination, and truncation.

real_gameplay_trajectory.policy: seeded random policy through the shared evaluator and Contract v2 environment factory

deterministic_boundary_fixture.runtime_identity: the audited ALE/Breakout-v5 mode, difficulty, ALE version, and ROM checksum
deterministic_boundary_fixture.limitation: This fixture validates the exact documented raw-score boundary; it is not a captured full-clear gameplay trajectory.

limitations: The detector is enabled only for the pinned ale-py runtime, mode 0, difficulty 0, and exact packaged ROM checksum.
Completion time is reported in agent steps and ALE emulator frames; Python wall-clock time is not used.
